en:
🎬 Turn what you love to watch into your best language lesson.

SubDuo puts two subtitle languages on screen at the same time — the original on top, your language below — on Prime Video, YouTube, Netflix, Disney+ and TED. Read, compare and keep watching. No pausing, no rewinding, no switching tracks.

Stuck on a word? Hold Alt and click it. You get the meaning, the pronunciation and an example sentence in your language, right on the video — and one tap saves it to your vocabulary list.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ WHAT SUBDUO DOES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎯 Two subtitle languages at once, in one clean box
🌐 Pick any two of the subtitle tracks the title offers — detected the moment you press play
📖 Alt+click a word (or Alt+drag a phrase) to look it up without leaving the video; playback pauses for you
📒 Built-in vocabulary list: save, search, filter by language, play the pronunciation 🔊
🖱️ Drag to move, scroll to resize a line, arrow keys to nudge, align left / center / right
🎨 Text color, text transparency and background transparency — set separately for each line
☁️ Each site remembers its own setup, synced through your Chrome account
🌏 Interface in 12 languages

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📺 WORKS ON
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
▶ Prime Video — primevideo.com and the video pages of Amazon stores
▶ YouTube — auto-generated subtitles included
▶ Netflix
▶ Disney+
▶ TED

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚡ READY IN 30 SECONDS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1️⃣ Add SubDuo to Chrome.
2️⃣ Play a video on any supported site.
3️⃣ Click the SubDuo icon and pick one language for the top line and one for the bottom.
4️⃣ Watch and tweak: drag the subtitles, scroll over a line to resize it, right-click for colors. Hold Alt and click a word to look it up, then press Save. Your vocabulary list opens from the popup.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔒 PRIVACY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🚫 No account, no ads, no analytics.
💻 Subtitles are the files each site already streams to your browser. They are parsed and drawn locally — your settings and viewing history never leave your browser.
📖 Only when you look up a word, that word and the subtitle line it appears in are sent to SubDuo's explanation server to generate the explanation. Nothing else is sent, and nothing that identifies you.
🛡️ Permissions: "storage" (your settings and vocabulary), "scripting" (reconnecting open tabs after an update) and access to the five supported sites. It runs nowhere else.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 GOOD TO KNOW
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• No machine translation — only subtitle languages the title actually offers can be shown.
• Turn off the site's own subtitles, or the same line appears twice.
• Netflix lists only the subtitle languages its player hands out for your account.
• Word explanations are generated by AI and can occasionally be wrong. If the service is unavailable, saving to the vocabulary list still works.
• Detection depends on each site's player; if a site changes, it may stop until SubDuo is updated. Live streams are unverified. Requires desktop Google Chrome 111 or later.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📄 Privacy policy: https://ramune441.github.io/subduo/privacy-policy.html
✉️ Contact: https://ramune441.github.io/subduo/contact.html
